customManagers.description: Without a template, a regex manager can only replace a digest that is already there, so pinning fails.

packageRules.description: A re-pushed tag cannot change what the cluster runs. Helm charts and Crossplane packages cannot carry a digest, so they are left out.

description: Chart values hold the tag and the digest as separate keys.
The renovate comment rewrites only the tag.
ECR Public publishes no release dates.
Without a date, the 7-day wait never ends.
Skipping the date check lets aws-cli update.
xpkg.upbound.io publishes no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge cannot count.
The 7 days count from the branch's last commit instead.
CI runs only on pull requests, so the branch stays pending and the PR opens after prNotPendingHours.
rebaseWhen conflicted: a rebase is a new commit and would restart the 7 days.

prBodyNotes: ⚠️ WordPress core lives in the container filesystem, not the `wp-content` PVC. Whatever tag is pinned here is what a restarted pod runs - a self-applied update inside the pod is discarded on restart. Merging this is what makes the version durable.

To take a security release before the 7-day cooldown expires, tick this update on the Renovate Dependency Dashboard under **Pending Status Checks** to force the PR immediately. Editing the tag by hand also works and is faster.

description: 11.8 is LTS, supported until 2030-02.
12.3 LTS ends sooner, and 13 is a rolling release.
Lift this when an LTS outlasts 11.8.

prBodyNotes: ⚠️ This restarts the database of every WordPress site. Follow [Upgrade MariaDB](https://github.com/cujarrett/homelab/blob/main/docs/wordpress/README.md#upgrade-mariadb) before merging: confirm the new major is LTS, then back up every site.

description: PHP and Debian security fixes arrive as a rebuild of the same tag.
Digest updates skip the 7-day wait so those fixes land fast.

prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `cluster/argocd/spire.yaml` overrides the spire-agent `socketAlternate` image for CVE-2026-111497. If this chart's default `chainguard/bash` digest ships Brotli 1.2.1 or newer, delete the override in this PR.
⚠️ **Before merging:** run `/adguard-pre-pull` - AdGuard's `Recreate` rollout strategy plus `ctrl-1`'s DNS pointing only at AdGuard itself means a cold image pull will fail with `ImagePullBackOff`.

description: One PR per update.
A merge applies to the cluster, so each change must revert on its own.
Per-package automerge rules only work when the package is alone on its branch.
Each Upbound AWS provider requires provider-family-aws at its own exact version.
Bumped one at a time, the newer provider never starts and its resources stop reconciling.
Placed after the groupName null rule, which would otherwise split the group.
cluster/monitoring/istio-proxy-scan.yaml scans the proxy image istiod injects.
One PR moves the three Istio charts and that image together, so the scan never checks a version no pod runs.
Placed after the groupName null rule, which would otherwise split the group.
A person merges these.
AdGuard: run /adguard-pre-pull first.
spire minor or major: can put the agent out of step with workload-identity-sidecar.
spire chart patches keep the same appVersion.
The agent stays in step with workload-identity-sidecar, so patches automerge.
Minor and major still go to a person, per the rule above.
main has no required checks, so GitHub auto-merge would merge before CI finishes.
Renovate merges instead, and only once render-check and kubeconform pass.
Last so it overrides every platformAutomerge above.
